svg.desc: GoodEWorkers, health-and-hospitals. Recursive partition in flat colour, after Book of 100 plates B012, B011, B019, B092. Structure: frame and composition cuts; process: recursive bisection at 0.3-0.7; mark: one rule per cut, 4 / 3.5 / 3 / 2.5 / 2 by depth, flat fills. Parameters: block 704 x 120 bisected at 0.3-0.7 to depth 5, min 72; an 80 x 56 roof cell on top; six of the smaller rooms lit in spill, none touching; a pulse line at the frame weight along the roof top, one beat just before the roof. Seed: rng("health-2"), book-core.js.
